input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

doc_friction.issue: Milestone 1 blamed its evaluation cap on the similarity gauge; the main cause was scipy trf/lsmr crawling (LM with a dense analytic Jacobian converges in ~25 evaluations), and holding the reference pose fixed did not pin the scale because init_fronto puts that camera at the origin. Recorded in the M2 log entry.

The fixed 120 s foreground limit plus a hook that blocks `sleep N; cmd` meant waiting on a 10-min sweep needed platform/ci/wait_for.py --until; CLAUDE.md names wait_for.py only in research/CLAUDE.md, worth a pointer at the root.

deviations.why: Landing work step 2 (work through open research PRs before building) was not done: 90 open PRs, and pick_track's CLAIM CHECK reported none touching this programme.
deviations.did: Advanced the drawn programme directly after the claim check.
deviations.result: One milestone landed; other PRs untouched.

deviations.why: Milestone 2 names rotation-only subsets; the OpenCV set has a moving board and no rotation-only views.
deviations.did: Used near-parallel-board subsets as the near-critical set and said so in LOG and README.

notes: Programme sensing-selfcal milestone 2 (pre-registered). 560/560 solves converged. H2 rerun held (rms z 1.945 vs 1.944), H6 held (rho -0.46/-0.58), H7 refuted (near-critical rms z 2.41; Zhang 5.83), H4 first gate refuted (reject bad 92%, accept good 84%). Checks run locally: pytest 8 passed; research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links ok; check_md_links ok; post frontmatter/links/similarity ok. No new DOIs cited beyond PROPOSAL.md (cite_check unreachable per M1).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: solver debug + analytic Jacobian + 560-solve study + write-up, a PhD student's working day plus

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
